# design — UI, UX and visual work

> Craft, not filter. The adjacent `antislop` skill is the filter (what to
> avoid: generic AI slop); this skill is the craft (what to build and why).
> Read both when building or reshaping an interface.

## How to use it

1. Pick the parts that match the task from the table below and read those files.
   Nothing here needs to be read in full before starting.
2. For end-to-end pipeline work (brand direction -> tokens -> layout ->
   components -> states), start at `parts/dembrandt/` — it is the orchestrator
   of the six ordered stages and points back into the parts below.
3. When brand direction is missing, say so: without direction the output drifts
   to default taste. Offer to capture it in `DESIGN.md` (parts `brand`,
   `extract-design`, `generate-ui-from-brand`).

## Boundaries

- Loading every part is wrong by construction — this skill exists so a session
  loads one contract and opens one part, instead of carrying 55 skill contracts.
- Accessibility claims need the checkers in `parts/wcag-accessibility/` and
  `parts/impeccable/`; `antislop` also carries a contrast checker in
  `scripts/contrast-check.py`.
- These parts are contracts, not scripts to run blindly: each says what it
  needs and what it refuses to assume.
